question: What comprehensive division of octads does the seeker wish to know fully?
premises: The subject is a division into eight groups of eight.
The seeker desires complete knowledge of this division.
The knowing is sought in an exhaustive manner.
inference: The seeker wishes to know fully and exhaustively the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: The adverbial sense of anantathā may imply boundless detail or endless extent.
plain_english: I wish to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
